notes.title: Proton & Electron Wins the Gold Award (University Track) in GWB Game Awards 2024
notes.content:
This achievement recognizes Proton & Electron's creativity and quality. Throughout the development, we aim to create a unique gaming experience that explores the intersection of science and entertainment. This award is a significant milestone and will encourage us to continue pushing forward!

We are grateful for this opportunity to join this year's GWB Game Awards and reviewers' appreciation of our work. Most importantly, we are grateful for all the players who support us. It is your feedback and support that drive us to keep improving.

The Proton & Electron Demo is now available on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3356670/Proton__Electron_Demo/]Steam store page[/url]. Please try it out, dive into this extraordinary world where science meets fantasy, and join Dr. Proton and the Electron Sprite on their adventurous journey! We look forward to your feedback as we refine the game to bring you an even better experience.

And don't forget to add to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334360/Proton__Electron/]wishlist[/url]!
